headline: Weathered Expanse Turns to Colonials; Stlican Shelf Shifts Again
war_summary: Since the last edition the principal change is in Weathered Expanse. The sector that stood six Warden posts to three Colonial now shows the numbers reversed: Warden three, Colonial six, with the heaviest casualty columns in the present returns and recorded events still coming through at the latest cutoff. Mooring County has not altered its nine-to-three Warden count, but it has been nearly as busy, logging seven events in the last two hours and keeping Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut among the day's busiest markers. Stlican Shelf has shifted again: Warden posts fell from five to three, Colonial posts stand at five, and one post is neutral, Fort Hoarfrost again the most frequently touched marker. Farranac Coast is all-Colonial and comparatively quiet after its earlier turnover. Stonecradle has not stirred since morning and remains one Warden post to eight Colonial. Callahans Passage is still wholly Warden, though its casualty list is tremendous. No winner has been declared.
